summary: The prepared main checkout still omitted use_dp_attention_reduce when MiMo's audio encoder constructed VisionAttention. A focused failing-before/passing-after regression verifies that AudioEncoderAttention now follows the runtime DP-attention setting, selecting the attention-TP reduction path only when DP attention is enabled. Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37060 independently contains the same source correction but was still open and absent from the prepared base.

tests.what_was_measured: Both DP-attention boundary cases failed because mimo_audio had no is_dp_attention_enabled wiring; raw output: reports/j-e70937ad1879/regression-before.txt
The VisionAttention constructor receives use_dp_attention_reduce=False when DP attention is disabled and True when enabled; 2 tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-e70937ad1879/regression-after.txt
Changed Python files compile and the patch has no whitespace errors.

Torch executed a 4x4 matmul on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950-class) GPU and matched the independent CPU result within 4.76837158203125e-07; raw output: reports/j-e70937ad1879/gpu-environment.txt. This does not exercise distributed MiMo serving.

gpu_execution.evidence: One ROCm device was visible (AMD Instinct MI355X, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015) and executed the retained numerical probe in reports/j-e70937ad1879/gpu-environment.txt.

remaining_limitations: The assigned environment has one gfx950-class GPU, not the reported 8xH200 topology, so the full TP=8/DP=2 collective hang and recovery after an audio request were not reproduced.
MiMo-V2.5 weights were not available locally; no claim is made about full-model audio semantics, FP8 behavior, CUDA/NCCL, or HTTP serving.
The regression validates the issue-specific collective-routing decision at construction time; it does not execute a multi-rank attention-TP collective.
No native code changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
